summary.creative_priority: Reusable basic traversal and a demonstration of optional original collision behaviour; not a new creative family.

visual_review.actual_method: Viewed a chronological 12-tile contact sheet extracted from the native MP4 with view_image. This is AI visual sampling, not manual play or human real-time observation.
visual_review.observation: The actor approaches a high rock face, jumps, shoots back and down toward the bell, rises beside the face while the gate opens, and walks along the crest to the 8-coin exit.
visual_review.readability: The bell and high shore are visible. The jump, opening and climb are legible, but the removal of horizontal burst is too brief and subtle in overview to explain itself without raw data. It may read as an ordinary recoil climb.
visual_review.boredom_risk: Much of the 5.77-second movie consists of approach and crest walking around one short jump-shot. Useful as a small traversal beat; weak as an independent creative pitch. No human boredom rating or feel is claimed.
visual_review.detached_movie_scope: No detached native MP4 was viewed in this audit. Its mechanics and cost comparison come from verified raw data.

mechanism_audit.actual_original_source: PlayerMotor calls move_and_slide, then removes the inward normal component from recoil_velocity. The local observer/runner/main read contacts, recoil_velocity and burst without writing actor, resources or world state.

alternatives_and_recovery.accepted: Several actual detached one-shot routes and two-shot, one-jump ground-preopening policies remain legal. They need not mimic the near-wall strategy or open the permanent gate in midair.
alternatives_and_recovery.miss_retry: One core-v2 clean x596/h20 control completes in 345 frames, with shots at 172 and 237. Between miss and retry the actor lands on original Platform0 with gun=1, cooldown=0, jumps=0 and energy=100. Same geometry, distinct fixture control; no generic nominal-miss recovery qualification.
alternatives_and_recovery.sameworld_return: One 525-frame clean A→B→A sequence uses one shot and one jump. The original permanent gate is already open on return. The actor ends grounded at A with gun=1, energy=100, jumps=0, no reset and actor_epoch=1. This does not qualify fresh B→A from an initially closed gate or reverse regular/held conditions.
